THE REMAINING SHORTFALL IS RECORDED AGAINST THE GAUSSIAN CONTACT MODEL. Every boundary
it produces is smoothed by construction: P ~ <R^2>^(-3/2) is a thermal average, and
averaging over configurations averages again, so a sharp insulation dip cannot survive
two averagings. That is the same wall loops 36, 39 and 40 hit, and its cost is now
measured rather than asserted: +0.1495 of correlation.
